editorial: Today, there is a noticeable intensity in software development processes focusing on security audits and local hardware solutions. Fujitsu's new generation CPU announcement and the proliferation of open-source security tools indicate that the industry is shifting toward tangible gains in both infrastructure and audit layers.

items.title: alibaba/open-code-review
items.summary: Open-code-review, developed by Alibaba, offers a hybrid architecture that combines deterministic pipelines with large language models (LLMs) to automate code review processes. Designed to detect software security vulnerabilities and provide line-based feedback, this tool is compatible with various artificial intelligence models.

items.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
items.summary: security-audit-skill, developed by Cloudflare, is a skill package that enables coding agents to perform multi-stage security audits. It automates security standards in software development processes by producing machine-readable and independently verified findings.

items.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
items.summary: agent-skills, shared by Addy Osmani, offers production-level engineering skills for AI coding agents. This JavaScript-based library aims to standardize autonomous software development processes.

items.title: Tencent/BrowserSkill
items.summary: BrowserSkill, developed by Tencent, is a browser automation tool that allows AI agents to manage active browser sessions without interrupting the user's work. Through a command-line interface and browser extension, it allows any AI agent to access existing logged-in browser data.

items.title: alphaXiv/OpenResearch
items.summary: AlphaXiv provides a framework that transforms coding-focused software agents into research agents capable of conducting scientific research processes. Developed in Rust, this open-source tool aims to automate tasks such as complex data analysis and academic literature review.

items.title: anthropics/claude-code
items.summary: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that runs on the terminal and accelerates software development processes with natural language commands. It analyzes the codebase to perform routine tasks, explains complex code blocks, and manages workflows related to the version control system Git.

items.title: NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra
items.summary: Ghidra, developed by the National Security Agency (NSA), is a comprehensive analysis framework used for software reverse engineering operations. Written in Java, this tool offers visualization and debugging features to analyze binary files and understand the operational logic of code.

items.title: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
items.summary: knowledge-work-plugins, shared by Anthropic, is an open-source plugin library that allows knowledge workers to create customized workflows on the AI assistant Claude (AI model). This Python-based toolkit enables users to automate productivity processes and standardize complex tasks.

items.title: Tencent/WeKnora
items.summary: WeKnora, developed by Tencent, is an open-source platform that transforms raw documents into a queryable knowledge base (RAG), an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-updating wiki system. Written in the Go programming language, this tool aims to convert unstructured data into enterprise-level accessible knowledge assets.

items.title: abue-ammar/tinycast
items.summary: Tinycast is a lightweight application launcher, shortcut manager, and clipboard history tool developed for the macOS operating system. Written in Swift, this native software aims to accelerate desktop workflows by using system resources efficiently.

items.title: cilium/cilium
items.summary: Cilium is an infrastructure tool that uses eBPF technology to manage network traffic, provide security, and offer system observability. It is particularly preferred for managing the network layer with high performance in container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.

items.title: jamiepine/voicebox
items.summary: Voicebox, developed by Jamiepine, is an open-source AI voice studio where users can perform voice cloning, dictation, and speech generation. Written in TypeScript, this tool consolidates voice processing workflows into a single platform for the user.

items.title: affaan-m/ECC
items.summary: ECC is a performance system that optimizes capability, memory, and security layers for AI agents. It provides an infrastructure designed to increase the operational efficiency of coding assistants such as Claude Code and Cursor.

items.title: roboflow/supervision
items.summary: Supervision, developed by Roboflow, is a Python library that provides reusable tools for computer vision projects. It accelerates image processing workflows by standardizing common tasks such as object tracking and visualization.

items.title: JustVugg/colibri
items.summary: Colibri is a C engine that enables running the mixture of experts architecture, one of the most advanced types of large language models, on local devices with low hardware requirements. By loading expert layers via disk streaming, it allows models that require high memory to run on standard computers.

items.title: TencentCloud/Octop
items.summary: Octop, developed by TencentCloud, is a multi-user and multi-agent AI assistant that you can host on your own server. This Python-based system allows different users to interact with multiple AI agents simultaneously.

items.title: ever-co/ever-gauzy
items.summary: Ever Gauzy is an open-source business management platform that brings together business processes such as enterprise resource planning (ERP), customer relationship management (CRM), and human resources under one roof. Developed with TypeScript, this system combines the software tools needed by different departments into a centralized structure.

items.title: cline/cline
items.summary: Cline is an autonomous coding agent that automates software development processes. It integrates into developers' projects by operating via an IDE extension, software development kit (SDK), or command-line interface (CLI).

items.title: coder/coder
items.summary: Coder is a platform that provides secure development environments for software developers and AI agents. Thanks to its cloud-based infrastructure, it allows you to manage development environments centrally by standardizing coding processes.

items.title: n8n-io/n8n
items.summary: n8n is a visual workflow automation platform that automates data flow between different applications. Users can create custom processes on their own servers or in the cloud, thanks to support for over 400 integrations and built-in AI capabilities.

items.title: Hister: A private search engine for the pages you visit and the files you keep
items.summary: Hister is a private search engine that allows you to perform fast searches across visited web pages and local files by indexing them. Providing users with full control over their own data, this tool offers a privacy-focused personal search experience.

items.title: Fujitsu launches made-in-Japan next-generation CPU FUJITSU-MONAKA
items.summary: Fujitsu has announced its new generation processor (CPU), FUJITSU-MONAKA, which focuses on energy efficiency for data centers. Manufactured in Japan, this processor offers an architecture optimized for high-performance computing (HPC) and AI workloads.

items.title: Astra for Law
items.summary: Astra for Law, developed by OpenAI, is a specialized AI tool that enables legal professionals to analyze complex legal documents. Designed to increase efficiency in legal processes, this system automates large-scale file review and legal research tasks.

items.title: Bend – A language that blocks AI mistakes via proof, on CPU and GPU
items.summary: Bend is a programming language that can run in parallel on both the CPU and GPU, and prevents logical errors through formal verification. It enables software developers to perform complex parallel computations in a safer and more error-free manner.

items.title: Bonsai 2 27B: Near-Lossless Compression in a 9x Smaller Footprint
items.summary: Bonsai 2 27B, developed by PrismML, is a compression technology that reduces large language models to nine times their original size while maintaining their original performance. This method lowers the hardware requirements for AI models, allowing them to run on lower-capacity devices.

items.title: Edge0/Edge0-35B-A3B-preview
items.summary: Edge0-35B-A3B-preview is an AI model released on the Hugging Face platform that focuses on text generation. Offering an open-source alternative to developers, this model is designed to perform complex language processing tasks.

items.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
items.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, developed by DeepSeek, is a multimodal AI model capable of processing visual and textual data. It is designed to analyze input images and text to generate meaningful text outputs.

items.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
items.summary: Qwen2.5-27B, developed by Alibaba, is a multimodal AI model capable of processing both text and visual data. It stands out as a high-performance language and image processing tool on HuggingFace, the platform where open-source AI models are shared.

items.title: m-a-p/YuE2-3B
items.summary: YuE2-3B, released on Hugging Face, is an AI model with text-to-audio conversion capabilities. It aims to provide a high-performance alternative for music and audio production processes.

items.title: TokenRhythm/NeoHorse-1-4B
items.summary: NeoHorse-1-4B, developed by TokenRhythm, is an AI model focused on text generation. Thanks to its low parameter count, it offers fast text generation processes by using hardware resources efficiently.

items.title: FAMOS: Feed-Forward 3D Articulation Modeling from Sparse Observations
items.summary: FAMOS is a feed-forward model that estimates joint parameters by segmenting moving parts from sparse and irregular point clouds. It aims to model the 3D articulation structure of objects more accurately by processing multiple data points together rather than relying on single observations.

items.title: When EOS Tokens Disagree: Understanding Length Inflation in On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: In on-policy distillation processes, the issue of length inflation, which causes student models to generate unnecessarily long responses, is being examined. The research reveals that this behavior is caused by a mismatch regarding end-of-sequence (EOS) tokens between base student models and teacher models that have undergone post-training processes.

items.title: PACT: Can Enterprise AI Assistants Be Trusted Under Pressure?
items.summary: PACT is an evaluation framework that measures the extent to which enterprise AI assistants maintain compliance rules under pressure in sensitive processes. It aims to systematically analyze the rule-violation tendencies of large language models used in fields such as recruitment, healthcare, and finance.

items.title: WeVisDoc: From Coverage to Capability for Robust End-to-End Document Parsing
items.summary: WeVisDoc addresses the data bias problem encountered in document parsing processes, which convert document images into structured text, with a two-stage framework. The system strengthens end-to-end parsing performance by both increasing content diversity and using a data-centric approach that targets the model's weak points.

items.title: RetireOPD: Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: RetireOPD presents a method for AI agents trained with reinforcement learning that regulates the supervision of the teacher model according to stages. This approach optimizes the student model's self-distillation process in situations where the teacher model is not always reliable, thereby increasing training efficiency.

items.title: I Don't Like LLMs
items.summary: Software expert Martin Fowler shares his criticisms regarding the integration of large language models into software development processes. He questions the potential negative impacts of these technologies on code quality and developer competence, drawing attention to the risks brought by automation.

items.title: Flock cameras are riddled with security vulnerabilities and hard-coded credentials
items.summary: Security researchers have discovered hard-coded credentials and various vulnerabilities in Flock security cameras, which provide license plate recognition technology, that facilitate system access. These findings indicate that devices widely used by law enforcement and private properties pose risks regarding data security.

items.title: The Golden Spike, and Resurrecting the Vale(n) Programming Language
items.summary: The Vale programming language is being redeveloped with Golden Spike, a new compiler architecture that combines memory safety with high performance. This work aims to offer the memory safety features provided by the Vale language on a more efficient infrastructure.
